 Order

This is first bail application of applicant Monu Khan while second bail application of applicant Smt.
Payal Raikwar @ Bharti Raikwar under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to F.I.R. No.894/2023 dated 12.12.2023 registered at Police Station Civil Lines, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 370,371,376 and 506 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Lines, District Chhatarpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicants are in detention since 14.12.2023.

First bail application of applicant Smt. Payal Raikwar was dismissed on merits vide order dated 20.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.4176/2024.
2 MCRC-25351-2024 2.
As per the prosecution story, 18 years old prosecutrix appeared in police station Civil Lines on 12.12.2023 and stated that she belongs to Dhanbad (Jharkhand).
She was working as a domestic maid.
She knew Suman Kumari for the last 08 months who isalso resident of the same place.
She had brought her Chhatarpur by alluring that she will manage some job for her.

It is alleged that on Monu Khan @ Ikhlaq Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161380879/
1 08.12.2023, she sold out her to Payal Raikwar and Brajesh Yadav.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thereafter, they both sold out her to Monu Khan, resident of Bus Stand Navgaon, Chhatarpur.

On 11.12.2023, Monu Khan got prepared papers of Nikah and compelled her to put her signature on some blank papers and thereafter in the house of Payal Raikwar, Monu Khan committed rape upon her and threatened to do death.
F.I.R was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicants have not committed any offence.
They are innocent.
They have been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial court on 27.05.2024.
She has not supported the prosecution story.

Therefore, it is prayed that applicants may be released on bail.
4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed grant of bail to the applicants but has fairly admitted that prosecutrix has turned hostile.
5. Considering the submissions putforth by learned counsel for the parties and the fact that prosecutrix has been examined and has not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, considering change in 3 MCRC-25351-2024 circumstances but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicants on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicants - Smt. Payal Raikwar @ Bharti Raikwar and Monu Khan @ Ikhlaq Khan be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

They shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE MKL Monu Khan @ Ikhlaq Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161380879/
